<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TransactionDataRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/transaction-data-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TransactionDataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TransactionDataRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_IP_Request" messageRef="Msg_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Data" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" messageRef="Msg_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_RejectRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" messageRef="Msg_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_INQ" name="Data request needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request" messageRef="Msg_TransactionDataRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAnswer" name="Receive answer from IP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_INQ" name="Answer received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_INQ" targetRef="Task_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAnswer" targetRef="EndEvent_INQ"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IP_Request" name="Request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_IP_Request" messageRef="Msg_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check request of INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Examination_Split" name="Examination outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitData" name="Transmit data to INQ" messageRef="Msg_DataTransmission">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RejectRequest" name="Reject request to INQ" messageRef="Msg_Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IP_Request" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Examination_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" name="Request valid" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination_Split" targetRef="Task_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" name="Request invalid" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination_Split" targetRef="Task_RejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="EndEvent_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_RejectRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TransactionDataRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/transaction-data-request">

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TransactionDataRequest" name="Transaction data request process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Participants">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_INQ" name="INQ">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_INQ</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TransmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IP" name="IP">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerInquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AnswerGiven</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_INQ" name="Transaction data request needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitRequest" name="INQ transmits transaction data request to IP" messageRef="Msg_TransactionDataRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="IP checks request of INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AnswerInquiry" name="IP answers question of INQ with transmission of data or rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AnswerGiven" name="Answer given">

rules.instruction: When the description says one participant sends a request to another participant, that other participant then checks the request, and the first participant waits for an answer that depends on the outcome of that check: Model the sending step as a task, the checking step as its own task placed after it, and the answer-receiving step after the checking task. Connect these three steps with sequence flows in that order. Do not connect the sending step directly to the answer-receiving step, and do not merge the check into the sending or answer step. Place any decision on the outcome after the checking task.
rules.situation: the description says one participant sends a request to another participant, that other participant then checks the request, and the first participant waits for an answer that depends on the outcome of that check

rules.instruction: When the description states that a named actor performs an action that is part of the process, such as submitting a request or signing up: Model that action as a task whose label keeps the actor and the action verb and object as written in the description, for example 'Actor verb object', rather than a shortened verb-object label that drops the actor. Keep the task after the start event that the description implies, and do not replace it with a separate start event or a user task that repeats the actor's action.
rules.situation: the description states that a named participant performs an action directed at another participant or its item, such as answering, checking or transmitting something, with the action stated from that participant's side

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant performs an action directed at another participant (for example a transmission, a check or a reply), and a task for that action could be labeled from the receiving participant's side (for example as receiving or getting something): Label the task with the acting participant as the subject, followed by the verb and object the description uses for that action (for example 'Participant A transmits the request to Participant B'). Do not rephrase the task as what the other participant receives or obtains, and do not swap the subject to the receiver, so the label matches the description's actor and action.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant performs an action directed at another participant (for example a transmission, a check or a reply), and a task for that action could be labeled from the receiving participant's side (for example as receiving or getting something)

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant replies to a request from another participant, and the content of that reply depends on the outcome of a check the replying participant performed, with the possible reply contents listed as alternatives within the same sentence: Model the reply as one task owned by the replying participant, labelled with that participant's name and the reply action in the description's own wording, placed after the checking task. Do not split the reply into an exclusive gateway with one send task per listed alternative, and do not model the requesting participant's side as a separate receive task whose label restates the reply. Use a gateway and separate tasks only when the description gives each alternative its own follow-up actions.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant replies to a request from another participant, and the content of that reply depends on the outcome of a check the replying participant performed, with the possible reply contents listed as alternatives within the same sentence
